instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief for QuarantineSpoke Disposition: The objective is to record, isolate, inspect, repack, and conditionally release inbound goods found damaged during receipt. Receiving Clerks record shipment references and affected items. Quarantine Handlers move affected items to the hold area and record visible condition. Inspection Specialists record one recommendation of release, repack, or return to supplier. Supplier messaging is outside the project. The damage categories are not finalized, and no role has been chosen to authorize a return to the supplier.

output.business_objective: Record, isolate, inspect, repack, and conditionally release inbound goods found damaged during receipt.

instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: Inspection and release overview: The Inspection Specialist examines a held item and records one recommendation: release, repack, or return to supplier. If repack is recommended, the Packaging Lead records the work as complete before release. The Warehouse Controller releases the item only when release is recommended or the required repacking is complete.

output.summary: The workflow records a disposition recommendation after inspection of a held item. Repack recommendations require the Packaging Lead to record completion before release, and the Warehouse Controller may release an item only when release is recommended or required repacking is complete.
output.primary_goal: Record an inspection recommendation and release an item only after an allowed release condition is satisfied.
key_capabilities: Record one recommendation of release, repack, or return to supplier.
Release an item under the stated release conditions.
